title: History and High Points - Brückner Group
content: What began as a medium-sized enterprise has grown into a global technology leader with firm roots, sustainable growth, and a spirit of curiosity and openness. Our four specialized business units – Brückner Maschinenbau, Brückner Servtec, Hennecke, Kiefel, and PackSys Global – bring together in-depth expertise in film manufacturing, servicing, industrial processing of PUR, thermoforming, and packaging. The founding of Paul Kiefel GmbH marks the first chapter in the story of a company that would become an integral part of the Brückner Group. What began as a small mechanical engineering firm laid the foundation for decades of technological expertise in plastic processing. In the following decades, the company evolves from a purely manufacturing business into a global engineering firm. With the inception of Brückner Far East, the company takes a visionary step into Asian markets. With Brückner Colombia, the Group takes its global presence into South America for the first time.
